Definition: Shemer, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shemer is the name of two men: a Levite in the line of Merari, and the man who owned the hill Omri bought for two talents of silver and built Samaria on. The city was called after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a hill bought for silver became a capital, and the owner's name stuck to it. Samaria is named for Shemer, and I hold that God remembers the small owners as well as the kings who buy from them.
